description.value: Pho Galaxy is a Vietnamese restaurant in Langley, BC, specializing in traditional pho, rice dishes, vermicelli bowls, and fresh appetizers made with premium ingredients. The warm, family-friendly dining room and a dedicated vegetarian pho menu make it a welcoming stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs. Online ordering and pickup are available for those who prefer a quick grab-and-go meal.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 47m; wave (3 spaces) at 82m; rack (5 spaces) at 93m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pho Galaxy is an active dine-in Vietnamese restaurant in Langley with online ordering and pickup available. OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes is directly corroborated by the website's explicit 'VEGETARIAN PHO' menu section. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM addr:unit is '104' but the website address omits the unit number; full unit address should be verified on-site.
Website copyright reads '2023' yet claims '15+ years experience', which may be a marketing exaggeration rather than factual history.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Vietnamese restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed contact details, and dine-in plus takeout service. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists in the Langley area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists a dedicated 'VEGETARIAN PHO' as a distinct menu section alongside a general vegetarian menu category
